prompt:
The orc armour-maker, beaming, holds up a finished breastplate made from a giant scorpion's plates, bound with sinew and bone toggles, a small horned skull fixed at one shoulder, for a wide-eyed human customer to try on. On the ground behind him lie the creatures the customer killed: a huge scorpion tail and a stack of dinosaur armour plates. Forge glow.

Setting: an orc settlement on black volcanic rock: squat, blunt houses of rough volcanic stone, timber and stretched hide; skulls and bones studded on as decoration and infill, wired on at wrong angles, a skull wedged into a wall where a rock would have done; a skull used as a flower vase in a window, a ribcage used as an herb-drying rack, a femur for a door handle; steam venting through snow between the houses, ash underfoot.

The orc badlands look: cold volcanic badlands: black rock, grey ash plains, steam venting through snow, hot hostile ground under a freezing sky; open and exposed, no cover anywhere. Orc buildings are blunt and honest: rough volcanic stone, timber and stretched hide, with skulls and bones studded on as homemade decoration, wired on at slightly wrong angles, crooked and mismatched, a grinning uncle's trophy wall.

Palette: black rock, ash grey, ember orange, snow white, bone, and the amber and rust of creature shell.

Characters (draw them exactly like this):
- The orc armour-maker: an enormous old orc smith, scarred forearms like tree trunks; grey-green skin, small chipped tusks, a braided grey beard, a huge earnest proud grin; wearing a scorched leather apron over bare arms, his own pauldron of scorpion plate, bone toggles in his braids.

Do not draw: Sauron or Mordor menace, buildings made entirely of skulls, a death-cult ossuary, glowing red eyes, evil snarls, menacing, sinister.

Style: Sword-and-sorcery comic art in the spirit of 1970s-80s Conan the Barbarian and Masters of the Universe: bold confident ink outlines, dramatic lighting, saturated flat colours with hard cel shading and halftone-dot shading, pulpy and dramatic. No text, no logos, no speech bubbles.

Composition: a tight crop from the middle of a larger illustration, so the artwork runs off all four edges of the image. Nothing surrounds the art: no border, no white or cream margin, no paper, no frame, no panel outline.
